stories.headline: Glasses recorded conversations without 'Hey Meta'; Meta says it's fixed
stories.subtitle: Owners reported everyday chats landing in the Meta AI app even with wake-word-free listening off, and some saw the LED turn on unprompted. Meta told Android Authority the issue is resolved but never explained the cause. Point customers to reviewing and deleting voice logs in the app.

stories.headline: NYT Cooking comes to Meta AI glasses with hands-free mode
stories.subtitle: The new recipe mode lets customers follow cooking steps hands-free on their AI glasses. One more concrete answer for 'what are these actually useful for' — and a great in-store demo angle pairing the assistant with the camera.

stories.headline: Malaysia launch: Gen 3 and Oakley Meta arrive Oct 20, from RM2,069
stories.subtitle: Four models hit Malaysia on Oct 20: Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 from RM2,119, Ray-Ban Meta Optics Gen 2 from RM2,209, Oakley HSTN at RM2,069 and Vanguard at RM2,589. Meta's global rollout keeps widening — a good sign if customers ask whether the glasses are still expanding.

stories.headline: Telekom sells Meta Ray-Ban Display in Germany at €899
stories.subtitle: The Display launched in Germany on Oct 13 through Telekom at €899 outright, or €1 down plus 36 installments of €22.10 on a MagentaMobil M plan. It's the first European carrier channel — a widening footprint for customers asking about availability outside the US.

stories.headline: Gen 3 in stores at $449; camera-free Audio shipped Oct 13
stories.subtitle: Gen 3 adds Aviator, Zena, a slimmer build and longer battery at $449; the $349 camera-free Audio line — no camera at all, for the privacy-conscious — started shipping Oct 13. Both are on shelves now, with the Meta Adventurer from $249 arriving Oct 23.
